description: Find the single best-matching company record. Requires a non-ambiguous input — name OR website OR ticker OR profile (website/ticker/profile resolve more reliably than name). Returns firmographics (industry, size, location, etc.) or a 404 'no match' body. API: GET /company/enrich.

pdl_id.description: PDL id for a company record.

profile.description: Company social profile URL, e.g. a LinkedIn company URL.

ticker.description: Stock ticker for a public company, e.g. 'AAPL'.

name: pdl_company_enrich
title: Enrich a company
